description:
Copper Point of Sale is open on the Windows desktop showing the main POS register screen. The system has some existing customers from real sample data.

Your task:
1. Navigate to the Customers area (use the 'Customers' button in the toolbar, or go to View > Customers).
2. Click 'Add' or 'New' to create a new customer record.
3. Enter the following customer details:
   - First Name: 'Maria'
   - Last Name: 'Rodriguez'
   - Email: 'maria.rodriguez@email.com'
   - Phone: '(555) 867-5309'
   - Address: '742 Evergreen Terrace, Springfield, IL 62704'
4. Save the new customer by clicking 'Save' or 'OK'.
5. Verify the new customer appears in the customer list.
